principles: Separate observations, coverage questions, improvement ideas and independently confirmed defects.
Preserve useful existing behavior; search the shared platform before building duplicates.
State the source version, evidence limits and next verification step.
Never treat sampled absence, a dated snapshot, a test definition or a permitted file reference as runtime proof.
A review decision approves work scope; it does not confirm a defect or authorize deployment.
Keep implementation capability separate from the evidence assessment. Reserve Needs manual fix for an explicitly identified capability gap.

inspector.mission: Identify specific InceptionApex source patterns for workflow and usability review and recognize useful existing behavior to preserve.
identifies: Existing save/approve and keyboard patterns to preserve
All recognized native confirmation callers, correlated editor-navigation signals and explicit verification criteria
Declared tablet viewport and assertion markers, including simple literal-array loops
Partial and unobserved rule patterns without treating absence as a verified fix
limits: Four approved files only; no screenshot, keyboard execution or live design assessment.
A source pattern is not proof of a runtime defect or accessibility conformance.
Bounded pattern recognizers cannot establish control flow, inherited CSS, unsupported syntax or tests outside the four-file sample.
inspector.handoff: Reproduce the experience with synthetic designs and record actual versus expected behavior before changing it.

master.mission: Inventory approved platform source, UI links, test definitions and dated Live/Sandbox metadata; identify the next verification task for each module.
identifies: Source and UI markers in the protected preview sample
Test definitions and dated schema/deployment differences
Checks needed before claiming a module works or is missing
limits: Does not run workflows, browser tests or live database checks.
Preview source and dated Live/Sandbox snapshots may represent different versions. Absence from the sample is not proof of absence.
master.handoff: Verify the current branch and deployment versions; reproduce the specific module workflow with isolated data before proposing implementation.

radar.mission: Find worthwhile improvements using a fixed product-quality rubric, while checking for shared capabilities we can reuse.
identifies: Essential capability questions and optional upgrade ideas
Sampled source signals relevant to a proposed improvement
Dependencies and verification steps to investigate
limits: Heuristic suggestions are not confirmed missing features or defects.
Does not search current external apps, providers or competitors, execute browsers, or measure product quality.
radar.handoff: Check existing platform functionality, confirm the business benefit, and define testable scope. Research current build-versus-reuse options separately where useful.

ai.mission: Explain bounded Master Scanner metadata and propose concise, evidence-linked follow-up work.
identifies: Potential improvements and verification tasks grounded in supplied metadata
Referenced approved files to investigate, not newly inspected source
limits: Model wording and file references are not independent verification.
No raw source, browser walkthrough, customer records, external research or automatic edits are included. A provider request uses the existing owner-started AI connection.
ai.handoff: Verify the cited files and actual behavior independently. Keep unsupported claims as investigation or dismiss them with a reason.

impact.mission: Flag possible cross-app and release impacts from an owner-supplied changed-file list.
identifies: Filename matches suggesting identity, payments, event, schema, deployment or shared-UI impacts
Independent reviews and regression checks needed before release
limits: Does not fetch GitHub, read file contents, resolve a branch to an exact commit, or execute tests.
Severity describes possible impact, not proof of a bug. An unflagged file or low-risk result does not establish safety.
impact.handoff: Inspect the exact commit diff and dependencies, confirm the affected apps, and attach isolated test results before a separate release decision.

inception: Save, reopen, approve and version artwork
Keyboard, mobile, labels and print/export constraints
Preserve shared designs, approved masters and event/product handoffs
